title: Harry Kane's Love Affair With Indian Cricket Deepens After RCB's Back-to-Back IPL Triumphs
excerpt: The Bayern Munich striker and England captain celebrated Virat Kohli and RCB's consecutive IPL titles on social media and offered his cricket services to the franchise.
body:
• England football captain Harry Kane celebrated RCB's IPL 2026 title win on Instagram, congratulating Virat Kohli on back-to-back championships.
  • Kane posted cricket photos on X in June 2026, tagging ECB and RCB with the message "Always ready if needed" — continuing a years-long playful association with Indian cricket.
  • The Bayern Munich striker has been an avowed RCB supporter since at least 2022, when he declared "My team is RCB" in a Star Sports interview.
  • Kane scored 61 goals in 51 appearances for Bayern Munich in the 2025-26 season while maintaining his cricket hobby with teammates.

From Football Pitches to Cricket Wickets

Harry Kane is one of the most prolific goal scorers in world football. He is also, by his own repeated admission, a devoted fan of the Indian Premier League — and he is not shy about it.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=lNQoyiF6oDg

When Royal Challengers Bengaluru defeated Gujarat Titans by five wickets in the IPL 2026 final at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad in June, Kane was among the first international sports stars to react. "What a player and what a knock @virat.kohli," the Bayern Munich striker wrote in an Instagram story. "Congrats @royalchallengers.bengaluru on making it back-to-back IPL titles."

Days later, Kane took to X and posted photos of himself playing cricket, tagging both the England and Wales Cricket Board and RCB with the message: "Always ready if needed, @englandcricket & @RCBTweets!" Bayern Munich's official English account shared the interaction, captioning it simply: "Game recognize Game."

A Friendship Built on Mutual Respect

Kane's connection to Indian cricket runs through his friendship with Virat Kohli, which began during Kane's tenure as Tottenham Hotspur captain. The two were photographed exchanging jerseys in London, an image that went viral — partly because both were then famously trophy-less at club level.

That parallel ended in 2025, when both athletes broke their respective droughts. Kohli led RCB to their maiden IPL title after 18 years, while Kane lifted the Bundesliga trophy with Bayern Munich — his first major trophy as a professional footballer.

"So my team is RCB. I have been lucky enough to meet Virat Kohli a few times and speak with him. Virat is incredible to watch. A real down to earth guy. He has fire in his batting and passion when you watch him play, which is great to see."

— Harry Kane, Star Sports Interview

In a 2022 interview with Star Sports, Kane had declared his allegiance openly. "So my team is RCB. They have picked up some great players this time," he said, adding that he had been following the IPL "for quite some time" and closely monitored developments in the tournament.

Cricket Runs in the Squad

Kane's love for cricket is no passing fancy. During his time at Tottenham, he was regularly spotted playing cricket with teammates including Gareth Bale, Eric Dier, Ben Davies and Joe Hart. He participated in batting challenges during The Hundred and once cheekily tweeted about being "disappointed not to be selected" when RCB announced their squad retentions.

Kohli, never one to miss a beat, responded to Kane's batting video on X with characteristic enthusiasm: "Haha good skills mate. Maybe we can get you in as a counter-attacking batsman."

RCB's 2026 triumph made them only the third franchise in IPL history — after Chennai Super Kings and Mumbai Indians — to win consecutive titles. Captain Rajat Patidar credited Kohli for his mentorship, while Kohli himself produced an unbeaten 75 in the final to seal the defense.

Dual Sporting Identities

Kane, who scored 61 goals in 51 appearances across all competitions for Bayern Munich in the 2025-26 season and netted five goals in five England appearances since September 2025, remains one of the most marketable athletes in global sport. His visible affinity for the IPL reflects a broader crossover trend between European football and Indian cricket, with both leagues commanding massive global audiences.

For the millions of Indian diaspora fans who follow both the Premier League and the IPL with equal passion, Kane's genuine enthusiasm for cricket — and his personal bond with Kohli — bridges two sporting worlds that increasingly overlap.
